scope: Initial six-task/21-case native use per arm; one context per arm, no feedback retry.

subject_identity.method_citation_limit: Identity/range verification and selected semantic entry/result excerpts, not whole-source audit.

protocol_finding.reason: Exact frozen subjects and packet agree; all 21 cases and required artifacts are present per arm; reported truncations were reacquired. No discovered unresolved event invalidates the fixed semantic comparison.
protocol_finding.unestablished: Full host context/exposure isolation cannot be proven from these persisted records. No claim that all tool or host activity is captured.

observed_protocol_events.effect_on_grade: No fixed witness missing in final return. Programmatic parse does not establish model retention.

observed_protocol_events.event: Six early local stdout byte counts missing; local acquisition log omits the later programmatic task read counted by harness.
observed_protocol_events.effect_on_grade: Harness successful emissions (23) supply the reported byte total; local unknowns remain unknown.

observed_protocol_events.event: Mixed task and combined three-frame output truncated; task and decisive bounded sections reacquired.
observed_protocol_events.effect_on_grade: No fixed witness missing in final return.

observed_protocol_events.event: Administrative finalization JavaScript failed parsing before execution; corrected artifact notes were written. Four early local stdout counts incomplete.
observed_protocol_events.classification: authoring/measurement event, not method semantic defect
observed_protocol_events.effect_on_grade: No semantic trial feedback/retry or changed case is evidenced; use frozen harness byte totals.

observed_protocol_events.event: Initial combined entry/task delivery truncated; all six tasks reacquired separately. One out-of-range source request failed before source emission; valid bounded ranges then acquired.
observed_protocol_events.classification: delivery and navigation event with recovery
observed_protocol_events.effect_on_grade: 40 successful logger calls versus actor local 41 including the failed interval; failed call is not silently counted as acquired source.

observed_protocol_events.event: Duplicate Delete/Add patch rejected without mutation; proper Update succeeded. Some early byte counts reconstructed and original task-all count unknown locally.
observed_protocol_events.classification: local authoring/measurement event, not method semantic defect
observed_protocol_events.effect_on_grade: No semantic feedback trial rerun; harness emissions supply bounded measurement.

observed_protocol_events.event: The selected source package was applied through its reported ordinary entry under supplied synthetic authority. Native Product status/verify and real install/adopt/release operations were not exercised.
observed_protocol_events.effect_on_grade: The task tests use of the selected method under the supplied fixtures; it does not establish successful native deployment or a changed operative Product basis.

method_defect_limit: No fixed assertion is contradicted. This negative finding does not establish absence of defects outside these witnesses, nor attribute every navigation/authoring event to method design.

measurement_basis.source: harness/MEASUREMENTS.json at the frozen result commit
measurement_basis.meaning: Acquisition is successful reader output bytes, including navigation, metadata, task repetitions and method content. It is not retained model context, attention, tokens or spend.
measurement_basis.source_io: Files read/hash-checked internally by the logger, not bytes delivered to the actor.
measurement_basis.raw_trace_limit: Frozen measurement summary and result hashes reconciled; raw acquisition traces were not replayed or independently recounted by this assessment. The logger was never invoked.
measurement_basis.failed_calls: Successful emission count omits failed interval acquisition; C discloses one such call.
measurement_basis.actor_local_totals: Incomplete and differently bounded local counts remain disclosures; they do not replace harness emitted-byte totals.
measurement_basis.harness_check: CHECK.json covers disposable logger behavior only, not source semantics, actor correctness or complete host isolation.

elapsed_disclosures.limits: Actor wall-time disclosures have different timestamp precision and include authoring. Acquisition windows are first-to-last logged read, not full task duration. Dispatch observations follow the tool call and are not host start times. No causal speed comparison is established.

bounded_comparison.semantic: All three arms satisfy every fixed assertion, with positive and adverse controls preserved. These cases establish no semantic advantage for C over A or B.
bounded_comparison.C_vs_B: C emits 54,619 fewer total acquisition bytes (16.09%) and 59,460 fewer method navigation/content bytes (22.96%) than B, with 14 more successful acquisition calls.
bounded_comparison.C_vs_A: C emits 49,191 more total acquisition bytes (20.87%) and 43,083 more method navigation/content bytes (27.54%) than A, with 17 more successful acquisition calls.
bounded_comparison.other_costs: Task reacquisition is also higher in C. Distinct source-file count, whole-file source IO, byte emissions, elapsed wall time and retained context are different measures. Neither fewer named source files nor fewer bytes proves structural elimination.
bounded_comparison.reconciliation: All arms perform the required semantic reconciliation. The trial does not instrument its cognitive effort or isolate a source-design causal effect.

calibration_limits: One actor per arm, one initial context reused across all six tasks. The 21 cases are not 21 independent replications.
Same inherited model family; neither independent model populations nor cross-model generalization.
No random assignment or repeated sampling is available to estimate variance or causal effects.
Package identities are visible to the grader. Oracle contents were frozen before the actors; oracle author and grader are the same actor.
Synthetic grants and declared complete source observations simplify actual project intake, authority and recovery.
Expected unknowns are valid semantic outcomes, not unanswered cases; enum/layout/algorithm differences are not failures.
Missing-return performance may remain unconfirmed while required coverage stays open; absence alone does not prove nonexecution.
No memory-derived evidence, paid model call, broader candidate audit or repeated review round was added during grading.
No member acceptance, overall superiority, structural-reduction closure, categorical-thread result, real consumer adoption, installation or release claim follows.
optional_fields: Own-source learning and fixture fields remain as supplied and are not extra grading requirements.
